findings.description: Once the first warming email is more than 42 days old, getWarmupLimit returns Infinity. EmailService.createEmail passes it directly to Email.add as csd_email_count, and the schema validator rejects it with 'Value in [emails.csd_email_count] is not an integer.' Every later newsletter fails before batch scheduling while warming stays enabled. Return the finite emailCount on completion.
findings.failureMode: An enabled warming domain older than 42 days causes newsletter creation to store non-finite Infinity in an integer field and fail validation or the database insert.
findings.title: Keep the completed quota persistable

findings.description: With more than 200 recipients, a first custom-domain send at noon gets a quota of 200, but another send one hour later is treated as day 1 and gets 236. Math.ceil advances warmup for every positive partial day, violating the same-day quota contract. Use Math.floor to count completed elapsed days; the unit tests currently freeze time at exact day offsets.
findings.failureMode: A same-day send with more than 200 recipients uses the next day's custom-domain quota because a partial day is rounded up.
findings.title: Count completed warmup days

findings.description: For day 1 the formula yields 236.701..., but Math.floor returns 236 where both updated suites require 237; days 20 and 30 similarly return one fewer recipient. The integration helper explicitly uses Math.round and all progression expectations agree with that rounding. Round the computed quota to the nearest integer so sending and the tests implement the same curve.
findings.failureMode: The normal day-1 quota is 236 rather than the required 237, causing the new unit progression and integration assertions to fail.
findings.title: Round the warmup quota consistently

findings.description: When the first warming-domain email is exactly 42 days old, this > check still applies a quota of 236701 rather than lifting the warmup cap. A million-recipient newsletter therefore continues routing most recipients through fallback after six weeks, and the new completion unit test fails. Use >= totalDays for the completion boundary.
findings.failureMode: At exactly six weeks the completed warmup remains capped, routing recipients to fallback and failing the day-42 unit test.
findings.title: End warmup at day 42

findings.description: This new declaration omits its semicolon, violating mandate 19. ESLint reports `84:57 Missing semicolon (semi)`, so the lint:types check fails. Add the statement terminator.
findings.failureMode: The changed day-lookup statement causes the repository's types lint check to exit with a semi error.
findings.title: Terminate the day lookup statement

findings.description: This new return statement omits its semicolon, violating mandate 19. ESLint reports `86:28 Missing semicolon (semi)`, so lint:types fails even after the completion logic is fixed. Terminate the return statement.
findings.failureMode: The new completed-warmup return independently causes a semi error and a failing types lint check.
findings.title: Terminate the completion return

findings.description: The quota declaration ends with `)` rather than `);`, violating mandate 19. ESLint reports `95:10 Missing semicolon (semi)` and fails lint:types. Add a semicolon after the call.
findings.failureMode: The new quota declaration's missing statement terminator makes types lint fail.
findings.title: Terminate the quota declaration

findings.description: This return omits its required semicolon, violating mandate 19. ESLint reports `97:43 Missing semicolon (semi)`, so lint:types remains failing until the return is terminated.
findings.failureMode: The missing semicolon on the new capped-quota return causes an independent types lint error.
findings.title: Terminate the capped return

findings.description: If nodes.conf leaves a populated slot unassigned (for example, CLUSTER DELSLOTS followed by SAVE/SAVECONFIG and a restart), clusterIsMySlot is false and this guard lets the cleanup delete all its keys. clusterClaimUnassignedSlots then sees an empty slot and cannot recover it. A restart reproduced DBSIZE dropping from 1 to 0; the base implementation claimed the slot instead. Skip slots with getNodeBySlot(i) == NULL during deletion.
findings.failureMode: A master restarting with persisted keys in an unassigned non-importing slot deletes the keys and leaves the slot unassigned instead of recovering ownership.
findings.title: Preserve populated unassigned slots during startup cleanup

findings.description: The new malloc call is declared deprecated in server.h, so the required make REDIS_CFLAGS="-Werror" build fails at this line with -Wdeprecated-declarations. It also excludes the 384 KiB slot-statistics buffer from Redis's used_memory/maxmemory accounting. Restore zmalloc in the common initializer.
findings.failureMode: The required -Werror build fails on the new malloc call; builds without -Werror also undercount slot-statistics memory.
findings.title: Keep the slot-statistics allocation on zmalloc

findings.description: clusterDeleteKeysInUnownedSlots is only called by verifyClusterConfigWithData in this same file, but its definition exports a new global symbol. This violates the mandatory rule that file-local helpers be static and unnecessarily adds it to the linker's global namespace. Declare this helper static.
findings.failureMode: The object file exports a helper with no external users, violating the repository's required encapsulation and adding an unnecessary global symbol.
findings.title: Make the new cleanup helper static

findings.description: The new 2.8.3 schema ID is out of sync with its generator: `build.rs` reads `metadata-v2.json`'s `tauri` value, which is still 2.8.2. Regeneration therefore changes this file and `crates/tauri-cli/config.schema.json` back to 2.8.2, breaking the generated-file check. Update the metadata's `tauri` value to 2.8.3 with the release.
findings.failureMode: Building tauri-schema-generator at the reviewed head regenerates both config schemas with /config/2.8.2 instead of their checked-in /config/2.8.3 IDs, leaving a dirty diff and failing the generated-file validation.
findings.title: Update the schema generator's version metadata

findings.description: The new homepage duplicates `workspace.package.homepage` rather than inheriting it, contrary to repository mandate 17. Updating the shared homepage will leave tauri-bundler publishing the old URL. Use `homepage.workspace = true` so its package metadata stays synchronized.
findings.failureMode: The newly added homepage is an independent literal rather than the mandated workspace-inherited field; a workspace homepage update leaves tauri-bundler metadata at the old URL.
findings.title: Inherit the workspace homepage

findings.description: Skeleton is imported but never used. The repository enables noUnusedLocals and treats unused imports as lint errors; running tsc -b --noEmit reports TS6133 on this line, and both ESLint and Biome fail here. Remove the unused import so the UI build/type validation can pass.
findings.failureMode: UI build and validate:types fail with TS6133; lint and Biome also fail on the new unused Skeleton import.
findings.title: Fix the unused import blocking frontend validation

findings.description: For an uncached flowId, useSuspenseQuery suspends into this boundary, whose omitted fallback renders null. It also intercepts suspension before the story's outer Loading... fallback, so the preview/component is blank until the request finishes. Supply a visible fallback on this boundary, as the existing FlowLink and DeploymentLink do.
findings.failureMode: A cold or slow flow-details request renders an empty component and suppresses the enclosing loading UI instead of showing a loading placeholder.
findings.title: Keep a visible fallback while the flow is loading

findings.description: There is no flow-icon-text.test.tsx alongside the new component, violating mandatory repository rule 10. Vitest cannot discover the required suite and exits with 'No test files found' when it is selected. Add the co-located tests for fetching, rendering, and the link target.
findings.failureMode: The mandated FlowIconText component suite is absent: Vitest's test selector finds no files and exits with code 1.
findings.title: Add the required co-located component test

findings.description: The API-v2 build emits CommonJS and start:prod runs plain Node, but @calcom/features exposes TypeScript source with no extensionless JavaScript makeActor module. This new runtime import throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND when BookingsService is loaded. Use the makeUserActor re-export added to @calcom/platform-libraries/bookings in this PR.
findings.failureMode: API-v2 production startup cannot load the newly added uncompiled TypeScript runtime dependency.
findings.title: Import the actor factory from the compiled platform library

findings.description: For a single PENDING booking, this constant makes the acceptance audit record ACCEPTED → ACCEPTED instead of PENDING → ACCEPTED; the added single-acceptance test also fails on this value. Use booking.status from the pre-update booking.
findings.failureMode: Single confirmation emits an incorrect previous status and the added single-acceptance test fails.
findings.title: Use the pre-confirmation status in the acceptance audit

findings.description: For an organization with auditing enabled, this queues recurring acceptance audits before any booking update. If an occurrence is deleted or a nested-reference update fails, the audit still records PENDING → ACCEPTED although persistence failed. Emit audits only for successfully persisted updates.
findings.failureMode: A failed recurring booking update leaves a durable acceptance audit for a booking that was never accepted.
findings.title: Emit recurring acceptance audits only after updates succeed

findings.description: A stored V1 REJECTED audit with rejectionReason: { old: null, new: "Busy" } now fails parseStored because V1 has been changed to string/null. BookingAuditViewerService does not catch this parse error, so loading that booking's audit history fails. Preserve V1 and add a versioned schema/migration for the flattened reason.
findings.failureMode: Reading an existing V1 rejected audit fails schema validation after upgrade.
findings.title: Version the incompatible rejected-audit payload change

findings.description: This new app-store utility imports a runtime helper from features, violating the mandatory app-store → features import restriction. Move the shared app-name helper to an allowed lower-level package and import it there to avoid the prohibited dependency.
findings.failureMode: New code introduces a forbidden app-store→features dependency under repository mandate 2.
findings.title: Keep the app-name helper below the app-store dependency boundary

findings.description: This actor-factory import introduces a runtime app-store → features dependency prohibited by repository mandate 2. Expose shared actor factories from an allowed lower-level package rather than importing the features package.
findings.failureMode: Actor creation adds a forbidden app-store→features dependency under repository mandate 2.
findings.title: Keep actor factories below the app-store dependency boundary

findings.description: The newly added Actor type import is also an app-store → features import, which the mandatory dependency rule prohibits without exempting type-only imports. Share the DTO type from an allowed lower-level package.
findings.failureMode: The new utility adds a prohibited type dependency from app-store into features.
findings.title: Use an allowed shared package for the actor type

findings.description: Collapsing the helper's generic type onto this line exceeds the mandatory 110-column formatting rule. Running Biome format on this file fails and expands the declaration. Restore the formatter's multiline declaration.
findings.failureMode: The mandatory Biome formatting check rejects the changed declaration.
findings.title: Format the helper declaration with Biome

findings.description: queueBulkRejectedAudit is added with four-space member indentation instead of the mandatory two-space indentation. Biome format rejects the file. Format the new method using the repository configuration.
findings.failureMode: The added bulk-rejection method violates the enforced formatting contract and fails a Biome format check.
findings.title: Use the required two-space indentation for the new method

findings.description: The new input object ends without the ES5 trailing comma required by the repository formatter. Biome format rejects this change; add the comma after the closing input brace.
findings.failureMode: The changed confirm call fails the mandatory Biome formatting contract.
findings.title: Retain the required trailing comma on the confirm input

findings.description: The newly added payment-success call is written with CRLF line endings rather than the mandated LF endings. Biome format rejects this file. Normalize the added call to the repository's LF format.
findings.failureMode: The newly introduced call violates the LF formatting requirement and is rejected by Biome format.
findings.title: Use LF line endings for the new payment-success call

findings.description: With the default trust directory and SSL_CERT_DIR already containing the expanded `$HOME/.aspnet/dev-certs/trust` path, Path.GetFullPath(prettyCertDir) resolves the literal `$HOME` under the working directory instead of expanding it. The directory is falsely treated as missing, so `https --trust` prompts to append it again and returns Partial (CLI exit code 4) despite successful trust. Compare with certDir and reserve prettyCertDir for display.
findings.failureMode: Configured default SSL_CERT_DIR falsely treated as missing; repeated append instruction and partial-trust result.
findings.title: Compare SSL_CERT_DIR with the real certificate path

findings.description: For a valid but not fully trusted certificate, `https --check-trust-machine-readable` now enables the event listener without --verbose. EventLevel.LogAlways enables all event levels, so GetTrustLevel's warnings are sent through ConsoleReporter.Warn to stdout before the JSON array, making the output invalid JSON for consumers. Do not enable this listener for the non-verbose machine-readable command.
findings.failureMode: Non-verbose machine-readable command emits warning lines on stdout ahead of JSON when trust is incomplete, breaking JSON parsing.
findings.title: Keep diagnostics out of machine-readable stdout

findings.description: If OpenSSL setup succeeds and SSL_CERT_DIR includes the trust directory (e.g. an override outside $HOME), but a discovered NSS database cannot be updated, sawTrustFailure is already true. This assignment overwrites it with false and returns Full even though the browser still rejects the certificate. Accumulate the missing-directory failure with the existing flag instead of replacing it.
findings.failureMode: Trust failure in .NET or NSS overwritten when OpenSSL certificate directory is configured; caller reports full trust.
findings.title: Preserve earlier trust failures

findings.description: On a case-sensitive Linux filesystem, with DOTNET_DEV_CERTS_OPENSSL_CERTIFICATE_DIRECTORY=/tmp/devcerts and SSL_CERT_DIR=/tmp/DevCerts, these are different directories. OrdinalIgnoreCase marks the directory as already configured and suppresses the instruction needed to establish OpenSSL trust, so the command claims success while OpenSSL clients still reject the certificate. Use an ordinal, case-sensitive comparison.
findings.failureMode: Different case-sensitive paths accepted as equivalent, suppressing required SSL_CERT_DIR correction and reporting full trust.
findings.title: Respect case-sensitive Unix directory names

findings.description: With the trust-directory override /tmp/base/trust and SSL_CERT_DIR=/tmp/base/link/../trust, where link points to /tmp/other/child, Path.GetFullPath collapses the entry to /tmp/base/trust but OpenSSL resolves it to /tmp/other/trust. The new check suppresses the corrective instruction and reports Full even though OpenSSL cannot find the trusted certificate. Compare resolved filesystem locations instead of lexically normalizing symlink/.. paths.
findings.failureMode: Symlink followed by .. is lexically collapsed to the certificate directory although it points to another directory, suppressing needed trust instructions.
findings.title: Do not equate symlink paths by lexical normalization

findings.description: The new NssDb constructor only assigns its two parameters to fields, the exact simple constructor-to-field pattern that AGENTS.md rule 11 requires to use primary-constructor syntax. The base already used that form. Restore the primary constructor rather than introducing an assignment-only traditional constructor.
findings.failureMode: Introduces a violation of the mandatory primary-constructor compliance rule for the assignment-only NssDb constructor.
findings.title: Retain the required primary constructor

findings.description: When SMTP_USE_TLS and SMTP_OPPORTUNISTIC_TLS are enabled but SMTP_LOCAL_HOSTNAME is unset or empty, replacing `smtp.ehlo(self.server)` with `smtp.ehlo("")` switches the greeting to the auto-detected container hostname. For a container named `dify.internal` using a relay that rejects non-public HELO names, the base sends the accepted SMTP_SERVER domain, but the new code receives a rejection and raises SMTPNotSupportedError before sending any mail. Preserve `local_host or self.server` in both STARTTLS EHLO calls (lines 34 and 36) so the optional setting does not break existing deliveries.
findings.failureMode: Unchanged STARTTLS deployment with an internal container hostname and a relay enforcing HELO DNS validation stops delivering registration/reset mail when SMTP_LOCAL_HOSTNAME is absent.
findings.title: Keep the STARTTLS fallback when the hostname override is unset

findings.description: `Firebase_Performance_Test` still uses Xcode 16.2, and the Firefox and Focus `*-ui-tests{,-previous-os}.yml` GitHub workflows select Xcode 16.1–16.3. These jobs resolve BrowserKit through Client or run `bootstrap.sh focus`, which calls `swift run` in BrowserKit. Their Swift 6.0/6.1 toolchains reject the new 6.2 manifest before building, breaking scheduled/manual tests. Upgrade these workflows to Swift 6.2-capable Xcode stacks and compatible SDKs as part of the migration.
findings.failureMode: The scheduled Firebase performance workflow fails resolving BrowserKit because its Swift 6.0 toolchain is older than the manifest's required Swift tools 6.2.
findings.title: Upgrade CI toolchains before requiring Swift 6.2

findings.description: The standard SVG test deletes `await fulfillment(of: [exp], timeout: 2.0)` and both fulfill calls, but `DefaultSiteImageDownloader` still uses Kingfisher's callback-based URLSession download with a main-queue completion. The test returns before those assertions run (and its local downloader can cancel the request on deinit), so a failed or missing SVG completion can pass unnoticed. Restore the expectation and wait for completion, as the other download tests do.
findings.failureMode: The standard SVG regression test passes without executing its asynchronous image assertions or detecting a missing completion.
findings.title: Wait for the standard SVG download to complete
